notes.title: New Game Mode for Vetrix!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We're adding new stuff to the game! :)

- [b]A new "Free Mode"![/b] That allows you to play without any time constraints, and has its own new 8-bit music track! 
- [b]More languages![/b] French, German, Italian, Spanish, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.
- [b]Two new color palettes![/b] See the image below to discover which palettes won our Discord poll.
- Some quality of life changes.

This new update is based on your feedback and we hope you'll like it.
Thank you so much for supporting the game! <3

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37696026/4a8477bd155e3c2cdeedc4ddc534da141341cd7c.png[/img]

notes.title: It's time for a surprise update! 😎
notes.content:
Hello, my lovely little pixels! 😁

With Vetrix reaching new markets, we're adding new stuff to the game!

[b]- New "Free Mode"![/b]
That allows you to play without any time constraints, and has its own new dope 8-bit music track!

[b]- More languages![/b]
French, German, Italian, Spanish, Chinese, Japanese (and Korean shortly after).

[b]- And of course, two new color palettes![/b]
That you can vote for by joining our Discord at the link below!
https://discord.gg/VtzJPaA

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37696026/05250c5bba519cf3392e7ddea8feb5a77171a535.png[/img]

The update will be live by the end of the month. 😉
